metric_definitions.population: All submitted jobs followed through completion; no fixed-window censoring
metric_definitions.pairing: Exact, unique, nonnull text job_name sets; original attributes must match after alignment
metric_definitions.harm_mean: Mean positive wait increment conditional on strict harm; null when no job is harmed
metric_definitions.harm_work_fraction: Original GPU work of harmed jobs divided by original GPU work of all jobs
metric_definitions.tail_thresholds: Strict wait > 1000 hours and strict wait > FCFS's exact maximum wait
metric_definitions.duration_quantiles: Original requested runtime in hours; linear interpolation; empty cohorts null
metric_definitions.quantiles: Linear interpolation as in pandas Series.quantile; no rounding before comparisons
